headline: Mammoth’s Dylan Guenther out 2-4 weeks with upper-body injury
take: Daily Faceoff reports Dylan Guenther will miss two to four weeks with an upper-body injury, Logan Cooley is day-to-day and Nate Schmidt is on injured reserve. That is three regulars from one lineup in a single update. Guenther has 12 points in 18 games and nine of them came on the power play, so the man advantage takes the first hit; he scored 40 goals last season and his chances this year (1.21 expected goals per 60) are right in line with that. Cooley is the bigger worry if day-to-day stretches: 21 points, 14 on the power play, and a hot streak our numbers call earned. Schmidt's loss is quieter but real; Utah has controlled the play when he's on the ice (62% of the expected goals at five on five). The Mammoth have been a better team than their 10-8-1 record, with 54% of the expected goals, held back by goaltending that has allowed about 12 more goals than expected.
